      "text": "AirFiber Refund Policy\nEffective date: 1 August 2026\n\nCustomers may request a refund within 7 days of first installation if measured speed stays below 50% of the subscribed plan during three official speed tests.\n\nRefunds are not available for:\n- Partial months on prepaid packs after the 7-day window\n- Charges for optional OTT add-ons once the promo code is redeemed\n- Equipment that is damaged or not returned\n\nApproved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days.\n\nTo raise a refund request, open a ticket in the AirFiber app and attach the three speed-test screenshots. Support ticket category: Billing > Refund."
    },
    {
      "article_id": "KB-002",
      "source_file": "billing_faq.md",
      "section": "Billing and payments FAQ",
      "product_area": "billing",
      "last_updated": "2026-08-01",
      "relevance": 0.3351,
      "text": "Billing and payments FAQ\nHow do I pay for AirFiber?\nYou can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.\n\nWhen is my bill generated?\nPrepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.\n\nWhat happens if payment fails?\nIf auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.\n\nCan I get an invoice?\nYes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.\n\nIs there a late fee?\nPostpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires."
    }
  ]
}

steps.content:
Hi Priya,

I’m very sorry that you’ve had to reach out three times without a callback and that the engineer missed your scheduled slot on 2026‑09‑04. I understand how frustrating this is, especially after you paid ₹1,999 for the AirFiber 1999 3‑Month plan.

**What our policy says**  
- For the AirFiber_1999_3M plan we provide *free installation within 48 hours* of the order 【KB-005†section=Installation timelines】.  
- Refunds are only granted when the service has been installed and the measured speed is below 50 % of the subscribed plan within the first 7 days 【KB-003†section=Refund Policy】. A missed installation appointment does not meet the refund criteria.

**What we’ll do next**  
1. **Reschedule the installation** – I’ve opened a priority reschedule for you. Our field team will contact you within the next 2 hours to confirm a new slot that works for you.  
2. **Callback** – I’m personally escalating this to our Field Dispatch lead to ensure you receive a call today.  
3. **Refund request** – Since the service has not yet been activated, a refund is not applicable under our current policy. However, you will not be charged any additional fees, and the ₹1,999 you paid will be applied to the new installation date.

If the new appointment still does not happen, please let me know immediately and we will explore further compensation options.

Thank you for your patience, and again I apologise for the inconvenience. I’ll follow up shortly to confirm the new installation time.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
AirFiber Customer Support  

*Sources: KB‑005 (Installation timelines), KB‑003 (Refund Policy).*
